cohort: The participants were placental tissue samples obtained from pregnancies complicated by fetal growth restriction (n=250), stillbirth (n=64), and healthy pregnancies (n=42).
finding: Fetal growth restriction (FGR) pregnancies showed higher numbers of CD68+ macrophages (with lower M2/total macrophage ratios) and FOXP3+ Treg cells (with higher Treg/total T cell ratios) compared to healthy pregnancies, while stillbirths also exhibited elevated FOXP3+ Treg cells.
